title: Containment Configuration Guide for Internet & SaaS

blocks.text: This configuration guide provides information on prerequisites and how to integrate Zscaler Deception with Internet & SaaS (ZIA).

With this integration, you can contain and isolate Zscaler Client Connector users within your organization who interact with landmine decoys deployed in the assets managed by your organization. When Zscaler Client Connector users interact with the landmine decoys, the activity is logged as an attack and the user information is shared with Internet & SaaS. Based on the user information, Internet & SaaS blocks internet access to those users across devices by moving them to a restricted group.
Before you configure the containment integration, ensure that you have:

blocks.item: Signed in to the Zscaler Admin Console, configured an IdP, and enabled SCIM provisioning.
Obtained the Base URL and Bearer Token of the configured IdP from the Zscaler Admin Console (Administration > Identity > Internet & SaaS > Internet Authentication Settings > Identity Providers).
Created a user group and configured a firewall filtering policy for the group with Block/Drop as action.
Installed Zscaler Client Connector version 4.1 or later across all endpoints.

blocks.heading: Configuring Containment Integration with Internet & SaaS

blocks.text: Follow these steps to configure containment integration with Internet & SaaS:

blocks.item: Step 1: Configure the Containment Integration Between Deception and Internet & SaaS
Go to Orchestrate > Containment.
In the table, locate Zscaler Internet Access and click the Edit icon.
See image.
In the Zscaler Internet Access configuration window:
Enabled: Select to enable containment.
SCIM Base URL: Enter the Base URL copied from the Zscaler Admin Console.
SCIM Bearer Token: Enter the Bearer Token copied from the Zscaler Admin Console.
SCIM User Group: Enter the name of the user group that was created in Internet & SaaS with the policy to block network traffic.
See image.
Click Save.
After the configuration is saved, click Test to verify network connectivity between the Zscaler Deception Admin Portal and Internet & SaaS.
Step 2: Configure Orchestration Rule or Take Action to Contain Detected Attackers
You can contain detected attackers automatically by creating an orchestrated rule or manually by taking action from the Investigate page.
Create a rule.
Go to Orchestrate > Rule.
Click Add Rule.
See image.
In the Rule Details window:
Enter the name of the rule.
Select Enabled.
Create a rule using queries and conditions.
See image.
Under Respond, enable Zscaler Internet Access.
See image.
Click Save.
The attacker is contained by Internet & SaaS in accordance with the conditions configured when the rule is triggered.
Take action from the Investigate page.
On the Investigate page, click an attack icon on the alert graph.
The attacker details pane opens.
See image.
Click Actions.
A list of actions that you can take to remediate the threat appears.
Click the Zscaler drop-down menu, and then select Contain with Zscaler Internet Access.
See image.
In the confirmation window, click OK.

blocks.text: After containing the detected attackers, you can view the details of the attacker.
